Northstar Developer Tools — Software Engineer, Early Career (synthetic posting)
Boston, Massachusetts, United States. Hybrid; full time.

About the role
Build reliable developer tools with TypeScript, Node.js and React. Design REST API services backed by PostgreSQL and Redis. Deploy Docker services to AWS and maintain CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions. Add OpenTelemetry instrumentation and debug latency regressions. Write integration tests and Playwright end-to-end tests. Build accessible interfaces and document technical tradeoffs.

Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience. Strong TypeScript, SQL, React and Node.js skills. Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, AWS, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, OpenTelemetry, Playwright, Integration Testing and Accessibility. Clear written communication and evidence of measurable performance improvements.

Preferred
Kubernetes and Go experience are useful but not required. Do not claim them if you have not used them.

Application
Provide contact details, education, recent employment, work authorization, sponsorship and relocation preferences. Answer why you want to join us and describe a technical challenge. Upload a tailored PDF resume. This is a local test application; no real application will be submitted.
